name: Bryn
title: The Trail Guide
line: Helps you think a decision through. Five scouts weigh it on their own, she looks for where the plan could fail, and she keeps your call so you never argue it twice.
jokes: Come in. Boots off if they're muddy. They're always muddy.
Stones stay where you lay them. Most decisions should be so lucky.
The Contrarian has walked back down the trail again. They'll come back with something I missed.
The Executor already has the pack on. The Executor always has the pack on.
I asked the sky about the weather. It said maybe. Skies and decisions have a lot in common.
If you can undo it, just decide. If you can't, sit down. I have a spare rock.
I'll tell you which road I'd take. You're the one wearing the boots.
Nobody has ever regretted packing a rain shell. I checked the stone path.
I go up the hill to look ahead. Also to eat my lunch in peace.
The Outsider asked why we don't just take the road. We're still thinking about that one.
Knock twice for a quick question. Knock three times and I'll light the stove for tea.

idle.label: At the trailhead
idle.caption: Nothing on the table. I'm on my rock with a cup of tea. Bring me a decision when you have one.

framing.label: At the fork
framing.caption: I'm writing your question on the signpost. Can it be undone? How much rides on it? That tells us how far to walk.

brainstorm.label: Laying out the routes
brainstorm.caption: I'm chalking every route onto the map, odd ones included. We'll rub most of them out soon.

council.label: Scouts on the trail
council.caption: Five scouts are out, each on a different road. They don't talk to each other until they're back.

review.label: Comparing notes
review.caption: The scouts are back with their hoods up. Each one reads the others' notes without knowing whose they are.

verdict.label: Marking the road
verdict.caption: We're round the fire, the scouts and me. I'm sorting where they agree and where they don't, then I'll mark the road I'd take. You still choose.

waiting.label: Your call
waiting.caption: My advice is on the signpost. The choice is yours, and there's no rush. Tell me what you decide.

premortem.label: Up on the hill
premortem.caption: Say it's six months on and the plan failed. I'm up on the hill, looking for where the bridge washed out.

filing.label: Laying a stone
filing.caption: I'm laying a stone for your decision. If it's a rule worth keeping, I'll paint a trail marker beside it.

consulting.label: Checking the stone path
consulting.caption: Before we argue this one again, I'm checking the stone path. You may have settled it already.

stalled: It's been quiet since {time}. Last stop: {stage}. In your next Claude session I'll offer to pick it up or close it.
parked: My advice has been on the signpost since {time}. No hurry. When you decide, tell me in a Claude session.
examples_idle: The stones here are made-up examples. Bring me your first real question and we'll lay your first stone.

rock.scene: Bryn on her rock with a cup of tea, a small bird coming and going from the signpost
rock.caption: Nothing on the table. I'm on my rock with a cup of tea. Bring me a decision when you have one.

trail.scene: Bryn walking the red trail, deer and a moose grazing far off
trail.caption: Nothing on the table, so I'm walking the trail. The deer don't mind. Bring me a decision when you have one.

kayak.scene: Bryn paddling her kayak down the stream, a heron on the far bank
kayak.caption: Nothing on the table, so I'm out on the stream. Bring me a decision when you have one. I'll paddle back.

contrarian.name: The Contrarian
contrarian.short: Hunts for the flaw in the plan

first-principles.name: The First Principles Thinker
first-principles.short: Asks what you're really trying to solve
first-principles.prop: Kneels at bedrock with a rock hammer

expansionist.name: The Expansionist
expansionist.prop: Holds a map wider than they are

outsider.name: The Outsider
outsider.short: Comes to it fresh, knowing nothing
outsider.prop: Sun hat, no map, off the trail

executor.name: The Executor
executor.short: Asks what you'd do on Monday morning
executor.prop: Pack on, one foot on the path

ui.ask_intro: Your question waits here until you send her up the trail, or for your next Claude session. Nothing runs by itself.
ui.ask_question_placeholder: Should I move my book club to Thursday evenings?
ui.ask_context_placeholder: Three of the five members work late on Mondays.
ui.ask_done: Left at the trailhead. Send her up the trail below, or say "Bryn, take up the next question." in a Claude session.
ui.ask_too_short: Write your question in a few words first.
ui.take_heading: Or send her up the trail now
ui.take_note: She takes the oldest question, frames it and checks the stone path. If it needs the five scouts, she sends them, which is up to eleven model runs. She stops at your call and never lays a stone for you.
ui.take_none: No questions are waiting. Leave one above first.
ui.take_no_claude: She needs Claude Code on this computer to go by herself. Until then, ask in a Claude session.
ui.take_going: She's out on the trail with your question. Watch the scene above.
ui.take_done: She's back. Your question is on the stone path, waiting for your call.
ui.take_stopped: Called back. Anything she finished is on the stone path.
ui.take_failed: She came back early. The details are in take.log in her data folder.
ui.path_intro: Every decision you make here becomes a stone on this path. Open one to read how it was made.
ui.search_hint: Type to filter the stones. Press Enter to ask Bryn to check.
ui.consult_decision: You've decided something like this before: {question}
ui.consult_nothing: No stone or trail marker matches. This is new ground.
ui.examples_banner: These stones are made-up examples for someone called Alex, so you can see how it works. They step aside when you bring your first real question.
ui.markers_intro: A trail marker is a choice you made once and want to keep, so the same question gets the same answer.
ui.markers_empty: No trail markers yet. One appears here when you keep a decision as a rule.
ui.marker_escalate: When to stop and think again
ui.report_council: Open the council's full report (new tab)
ui.report_premortem: Open the premortem's full report (new tab)
ui.advice_note: Advice from five viewpoints of one AI model. The decision is yours.
ui.error_load: Can't reach Bryn's server. Check it's running on this computer, then reload the page.
ui.footer: Bryn runs on this computer only. What you tell her stays in {where}.
